title.en: Extending the Insurance Coverage Provided Under Republic Act No. 4898, as Amended, to the Members of All Sangguniang Bayan, Authorizing the Appropriations of Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes

text.en:
Duly appointed or elected and qualified members of the Sangguniang Bayan of a province; city,
or municipality shall henceforth be entitled to the benefits accorded to barangay captains under Sections two,
three, and four of Republic Act Numbered Four Thousand Eight Hundred Ninety-Eight, as amended, subject
to the same conditions therein contained: Provided, however, That, if a member is eligible for coverage both
under Republic Act Numbered Four Thousand Eight Hundred Ninety-Eight and this Decree, his contributions
and benefits shall be determined under this Decree.

For the insurance benefits herein provided to members of the Sangguniang Bayan, the National
Government of the Republic of the Philippines shall pay an annual premium of Fifteen Pesos for every
member to the Government Service Insurance System.

The sum of Five hundred Thousand Pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the
National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the payment of the premium provided in the preceding
section for the first year of coverage from and after the date of the approval of this Decree. Every year
thereafter, there shall be authorized to be appropriated annually and included in the National Treasury not
otherwise appropriated, the amount of Five Hundred Thousand Pesos or such amount as may be necessary to
pay the succeeding annual premiums.

The System shall undertake periodic valuations of the insurance funds provided under this

Decree and under Republic Act Numbered Four Thousand Eight Hundred Ninety-Eight, as amended, and,
subject to the approval of the President of the Philippines, make such readjustments in the rates of premiums
as shall be necessary in order to meet the liabilities of the System under the said funds.

The System shall be empowered to prescribe and promulgate such rules and regulations as may
be necessary to implement the provisions of this Decree.

All provisions of law, decrees, and executive orders inconsistent with this Decree are hereby
amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect upon its approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 31st day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
